The Haunted House
The old house stood at the end of the street, its windows dark and empty. Sarah dared to enter, drawn by the mystery. Inside, the air grew cold. She heard whispers in the hallway. A child's laughter echoed from the attic. When she climbed the stairs, the door slammed shut behind her. A figure stood in the shadows, watching. Sarah ran, but the house seemed to stretch on forever. She never escaped.
